column1: # One row per narration segment, in order. Tab-separated. '#' comments and blank lines ignored.
# in    seconds to seek into the clip before the segment starts (skips page load / layout shift)
# speed playback multiplier; >1 time-compresses a real wait. Any segment with speed != 1 gets a
#       "Nx speed" chip burned in, so a fast-moving elapsed counter is never passed off as real time.
# crop  W:H:X:Y in MASTER coordinates (3200x1800), or '-' for the full frame.
#       A crop narrower than 1920 is upscaled; keep W >= 1600 to stay near native sharpness.
